text_en: Then the heads of the families of the Levites came to the priest Eleazar and to Joshua son of Nun and to the heads of the families of the tribes of the Israelites;
text_cn: 肋未人各家长来见司祭厄肋阿匝尔和农的儿子若苏厄，以及以色列子民的族长，

text_en: they said to them at Shiloh in the land of Canaan, “The Lord commanded through Moses that we be given towns to live in, along with their pasture lands for our livestock. ”
text_cn: 在客纳罕地的史罗对他们说：“上主曾藉梅瑟吩咐过，要给我们一些城市居住，一些郊区为牧放我们的牲畜。”

text_en: So by command of the Lord the Israelites gave to the Levites the following towns and pasture lands out of their inheritance.
text_cn: 以色列子民于是按照上主的吩咐，由自己的产业中，将以下的城市和郊区分给了肋未人。 肋未人，属大司祭亚郎的子孙，

text_en: The lot came out for the families of the Kohathites. So those Levites who were descendants of Aaron the priest received by lot thirteen towns from the tribes of Judah, Simeon, and Benjamin.
text_cn: 刻哈特家族由犹大支派、西默盎支派和本雅明支派的地域中，抽得了十三座城。

text_en: The rest of the Kohathites received by lot ten towns from the families of the tribe of Ephraim, from the tribe of Dan, and the half-tribe of Manasseh.
text_cn: 刻哈特其他子孙，按家族由厄弗辣因支派、丹支派和默纳协半支派，抽得了十座城。

text_en: The Gershonites received by lot thirteen towns from the families of the tribe of Issachar, from the tribe of Asher, from the tribe of Naphtali, and from the half-tribe of Manasseh in Bashan.
text_cn: 革尔雄的子孙，按照家族，由依撒加尔支派、阿协尔支派、纳斐塔里支派和由巴商的默纳协半支派，抽得了十三座城。

text_en: The Merarites according to their families received twelve towns from the tribe of Reuben, the tribe of Gad, and the tribe of Zebulun.
text_cn: 默辣黎的子孙，按照家族，由勒乌本支派、加得支派和则步隆支派，抽得了十二座城。

text_en: These towns and their pasture lands the Israelites gave by lot to the Levites, as the Lord had commanded through Moses.
text_cn: 以色列子民按照上主藉梅瑟所吩咐的，将这些城和城郊，以抽签方式分给了肋未人。

text_en: Out of the tribe of Judah and the tribe of Simeon they gave the following towns mentioned by name,
text_cn: 由犹大支派和西默盎支派，分给了他们下列各城：

text_en: which went to the descendants of Aaron, one of the families of the Kohathites who belonged to the Levites, since the lot fell to them first.
text_cn: 肋未人，亚郎的子孙，刻哈特家族应抽第一签。

text_en: They gave them Kiriath-arba (Arba being the father of Anak), that is Hebron, in the hill country of Judah, along with the pasture lands around it.
text_cn: 他们分得了犹大山区克黎雅特阿尔巴和四周城郊──阿尔巴原是阿纳克的祖先，克黎雅特阿尔巴，即是赫贝龙，──

text_en: But the fields of the town and its villages had been given to Caleb son of Jephunneh as his holding.
text_cn: 但已割给耶孚乃的儿子加肋布作产业的田地和村庄却不在内。

text_en: To the descendants of Aaron the priest they gave Hebron, the city of refuge for the slayer, with its pasture lands, Libnah with its pasture lands,
text_cn: 司祭亚郎的子孙分得了给误杀人者作避难城的赫贝龙和城郊，里贝纳和城郊；

text_en: Jattir with its pasture lands, Eshtemoa with its pasture lands,
text_cn: 此外尚有雅提尔和城郊，厄市特摩和城郊，

text_en: Holon with its pasture lands, Debir with its pasture lands,
text_cn: 曷隆和城郊，德彼尔和城郊，

text_en: Ain with its pasture lands, Juttah with its pasture lands, and Beth-shemesh with its pasture lands—nine towns out of these two tribes.
text_cn: 阿商和城郊，犹他和城郊，贝特舍默士和城郊，由这两支派共分得了九座城。

text_en: Out of the tribe of Benjamin: Gibeon with its pasture lands, Geba with its pasture lands,
text_cn: 由本雅明支派，尚分得了基贝红和城郊，革巴和城郊，

text_en: Anathoth with its pasture lands, and Almon with its pasture lands—four towns.
text_cn: 阿纳托特和城郊，阿耳孟和城郊：共计四座城。

text_en: The towns of the descendants of Aaron—the priests—were thirteen in all, with their pasture lands.
text_cn: 亚郎的子孙司祭们共分得了十三座城和所属城郊。

text_en: As to the rest of the Kohathites belonging to the Kohathite families of the Levites, the towns allotted to them were out of the tribe of Ephraim.
text_cn: 肋未人刻哈特家族，即刻哈特其余的子孙，由厄弗辣因支派抽得了一些城市。

text_en: To them were given Shechem, the city of refuge for the slayer, with its pasture lands in the hill country of Ephraim, Gezer with its pasture lands,
text_cn: 他们分得了厄弗辣因山区，给误杀人者作避难城的舍根和城郊，革则尔和城郊，

text_en: Kibzaim with its pasture lands, and Beth-horon with its pasture lands—four towns.
text_cn: 克贝匝殷和城郊，贝特曷龙和城郊：共计四座城；

text_en: Out of the tribe of Dan: Elteke with its pasture lands, Gibbethon with its pasture lands,
text_cn: 由丹支派分得了厄耳特刻和城郊，基贝通和城郊，

text_en: Aijalon with its pasture lands, Gath-rimmon with its pasture lands—four towns.
text_cn: 阿雅隆和城郊，加特黎孟和城郊：共计四座城；

text_en: Out of the half-tribe of Manasseh: Taanach with its pasture lands, and Gath-rimmon with its pasture lands—two towns.
text_cn: 由默纳协半支派分得了塔纳客和城郊，依贝耳罕和城郊：共计两座城。

text_en: The towns of the families of the rest of the Kohathites were ten in all, with their pasture lands.
text_cn: 刻哈特家族其余的子孙，共分得了十座城和所属城郊。

text_en: To the Gershonites, one of the families of the Levites, were given out of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Golan in Bashan with its pasture lands, the city of refuge for the slayer, and Beeshterah with its pasture lands—two towns.
text_cn: 肋未家族的革尔雄子孙，由默纳协半支派，分得了在巴商给误杀人者作避难城的哥蓝和城郊，阿市塔洛特和城郊：共计两座城；

text_en: Out of the tribe of Issachar: Kishion with its pasture lands, Daberath with its pasture lands,
text_cn: 由依撒加尔支派，分得了克史雍和城郊，多贝辣特和城郊，

text_en: Jarmuth with its pasture lands, En-gannim with its pasture lands—four towns.
text_cn: 雅尔慕特和城郊，恩加宁和城郊：共计四座城；

text_en: Out of the tribe of Asher: Mishal with its pasture lands, Abdon with its pasture lands,
text_cn: 由阿协尔支派分得了米沙耳和城郊，阿贝冬和城郊，

text_en: Helkath with its pasture lands, and Rehob with its pasture lands—four towns.
text_cn: 赫耳卡特和城郊，勒曷布和城郊：共计四座城；

text_en: Out of the tribe of Naphtali: Kedesh in Galilee with its pasture lands, the city of refuge for the slayer, Hammoth-dor with its pasture lands, and Kartan with its pasture lands—three towns.
text_cn: 由纳斐塔里支派，分得了在加里肋亚给误杀人者作避难城的刻德士和城郊，哈摩特多尔和城郊，卡尔堂和城郊：共计三座城。

text_en: The towns of the several families of the Gershonites were in all thirteen, with their pasture lands.
text_cn: 革尔雄人按照家族，共分得了十三座城和所属城郊。

text_en: To the rest of the Levites—the Merarite families—were given out of the tribe of Zebulun: Jokneam with its pasture lands, Kartah with its pasture lands,
text_cn: 其余的肋未人，即默辣黎子孙的家族，由则步隆支派分得了约刻乃罕和城郊，卡尔达和城郊，

text_en: Dimnah with its pasture lands, Nahalal with its pasture lands—four towns.
text_cn: 黎孟和城郊，纳哈拉耳和城郊：共计四座城；

text_en: Out of the tribe of Reuben: Bezer with its pasture lands, Jahzah with its pasture lands,
text_cn: 在约但河东，由勒乌本支派分得了位于旷野高原内，给误杀人者作避难城的贝责尔和城郊，雅哈兹和城郊，

text_en: Kedemoth with its pasture lands, and Mephaath with its pasture lands—four towns.
text_cn: 刻德摩特和城郊，默法阿特和城郊：共计四座城；

text_en: Out of the tribe of Gad: Ramoth in Gilead with its pasture lands, the city of refuge for the slayer, Mahanaim with its pasture lands,
text_cn: 由加得支派，分得了在基肋阿得给误杀人者作避难城的辣摩特和城郊，玛哈纳殷和城郊，

text_en: Heshbon with its pasture lands, Jazer with its pasture lands—four towns in all.
text_cn: 赫市朋和城郊，雅则尔和城郊：共计四座城。

text_en: As for the towns of the several Merarite families, that is, the remainder of the families of the Levites, those allotted to them were twelve in all.
text_cn: 其余的肋未人家族，即默辣黎的子孙，按照家族，共抽得了十二座城。

text_en: The towns of the Levites within the holdings of the Israelites were in all forty-eight towns with their pasture lands.
text_cn: 肋未人由以色列子民的产业中，共分得了四十八座城和所属城郊。

text_en: Each of these towns had its pasture lands around it; so it was with all these towns.
text_cn: 这些城包括全城和城四郊；每座城都是这样。

text_en: Thus the Lord gave to Israel all the land that he swore to their ancestors that he would give them; and having taken possession of it, they settled there.
text_cn: 上主这样将誓许给他们祖先的整个地区，赐给了以色列人；他们占领之后，便住在那里。

text_en: And the Lord gave them rest on every side just as he had sworn to their ancestors; not one of all their enemies had withstood them, for the Lord had given all their enemies into their hands.
text_cn: 上主又使他们四境安宁，全如他向他们的祖先所誓许的；他们的一切仇敌，没有能对抗他们的，因为上主将他们所有的仇敌，都交在他们手中了。

text_en: Not one of all the good promises that the Lord had made to the house of Israel had failed; all came to pass.
text_cn: 上主向以色列家应许赐福的话，没有一句落空，全部应验了。
